name: scrapalot
description: Claude Code tooling for the Scrapalot AI stack — corpus audits, RAG grading, an autonomous DevOps fix loop, and the per-stack code-quality passes.

plugins.name: scrapalot
plugins.description: The command, skill, agent and hook set that runs the Scrapalot AI stack: per-book corpus audits, RAG answer grading, an autonomous DevOps fix loop, competitive research to shipped feature, and the per-stack code-quality passes for the Python AI backend, the Kotlin backend and the React frontend.

commands.name: book
commands.description: ONE book, end to end — parse layer AND graph layer in a single pass, because parse defects are what usually break the graph. Never marches to a second book. Never skips silently.

commands.name: chat-pr-review-comments
commands.description: Read the review comments on a scrapalot-chat PR and fix the code until each one is resolved.

commands.name: chat-pr-review
commands.description: Review a scrapalot-chat feature branch end to end and open the PR if it is not open yet.

commands.name: chat-pre-commit
commands.description: Run the scrapalot-chat pre-commit hooks (ruff, secrets baseline, file hygiene) on changed files only.

commands.name: code-quality
commands.description: Full-stack code quality audit — model providers, database schema, Redis sync, dead code across all services

commands.name: competitive-analysis-closed-source
commands.description: Analyze closed-source SaaS competitors via their websites, docs, and feature pages

commands.name: competitive-analysis
commands.description: Analyze GitHub competitors — batch (auto-search by stars) OR single-repo strategy-first deep-dive when given a repo URL. Decides for itself whether the findings justify a PRD, and always states why.

commands.name: competitive-impl
commands.description: Implement the next feature from the research backlog — repairs misnamed research files, verifies the PRD against real code, interviews the owner in plain Croatian one feature at a time, then builds it on a branch with a PR. Multi-agent.

commands.name: devops-loop
commands.description: Autonomous DevOps fix loop — runs nightly, scans containers for the day's new errors, root-cause + fix one at a time on a branch, verify, open a PR assigned to sime2408. Never pushes to main.

commands.name: doc-sync
commands.description: Sync README documentation in docs/ folders with current codebase state

commands.name: improve-all
commands.description: Sequential code improvement: one phase at a time, one repo at a time. After each phase: compile → commit → push → STOP and wait for user. Phases: Code Style → Architecture (analysis-only) → Docker Verify → Audit. (No lint phase — pre-commit hooks cover linting.)

commands.name: mobile-fix
commands.description: Check and fix mobile layout issues for a given component

commands.name: pipeline-orchestrator
commands.description: End-to-end document processing orchestrator with OOM protection

commands.name: postprocess-graph
commands.description: Graph-only audit of ONE book whose parse is already clean. Loops until a separate critic agrees the graph is the book's graph — never a round count.

commands.name: postprocess-parse
commands.description: Parse-only audit of ONE book (no graph). Sweeps the corpus book by book so parser bugs get fixed at source before any graph is built.

commands.name: rag-test
commands.description: Drive ONE long chat session against a real book and grade every RAG answer (citations, search strategy, documents/web/llm routing, chat memory, source hallucination, graph, document_hierarchy). commands.name: ui-lint
commands.description: Run the scrapalot-ui linters and production build, fixing every error before the commit.
